title: %avg — arithmetic mean of an array
purpose: Reduce an array reference to the mean of its numeric elements.
notes: Sum divided by element count; a whole-number mean is emitted as an integer (##), otherwise as a number (#).
An empty-but-present array (a single ~ element) averages to ##0; a missing path yields ~.

avoid.snippet: mean = %avg @.nope  (path does not resolve to an array)
avoid.why: no array resolves, so %avg returns ~ rather than a zero or an error
